biotools.summary: miRStart 2.0 is a tool for annotating miRNA transcription start sites (TSSs) and identifying tissue-specific TF-miRNA interactions using a deep learning-based model. It integrates over 4500 high-throughput datasets and provides network visualizations to facilitate miRNA regulatory insights.
